shotgun.method: Body-only crouched-eye0.88m; walker0.64x1.82m,colossus scale1.22. Isolated deterministic12000uniform-diskdirections. Crowd reuses original scenario engine in-memory with exponential energy replacing falloff,16latticephasesx128triggers per distance; paired seeds. Fixed32m window only for a controlled close-range comparison.
limitations: Static ray geometry, no flight,drop,movingtargets,armour,headshots or death/overkill.
Transmission retention is applied as energy retention. The old additional30-50m penetration penalty is omitted only for physical candidates.
Contact boost cannot be preserved together with the same2-14m mean and one exponential without strong drag.
Pellets that miss one body may hit another: isolated hit probability alone cannot validate crowd balance.
shotgun.decision: kappa0.040,spread0.11 preserves exact2-14m mean and crowd weighted score within4%; accept contact-19%,4m+17%,12m-6% for isolated walker/colossus. No close-range multiplier.
